name: Heightened Confidentiality (Investor / Diligence Grade)
text: The Receiving Party shall hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall apply a standard of care no less rigorous than that which it applies to its own most sensitive information, and in no event less than a reasonable standard of care. The Receiving Party shall: (a) restrict access to Confidential Information strictly to those of its directors, officers, employees, and professional advisers who have a bona fide need to know such information for the Purpose and who are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less protective than those set out herein; (b) maintain a record of persons to whom Confidential Information has been disclosed; (c) not use the Confidential Information, directly or indirectly, for any purpose other than the Purpose, including for any competing, investment, or commercial advantage; and (d) promptly notify the Disclosing Party in writing upon becoming aware of any unauthorised access, use, or disclosure. Where the Receiving Party is evaluating a potential investment or transaction, the Confidential Information shall not be used to solicit, replicate, or compete with the business of the Disclosing Party.

legal_basis.note: Confidentiality narrowly targeting specific information is valid and enforceable
